review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The ideal candidate should have strong technical knowledge and hands-on experience in designing, proposing, and presenting advanced networking solutions, with solid expertise in Huawei, HPE Aruba, GPON, and wireless technologies. Key Responsibilities: - Design and develop comprehensive network solutions based on customer requirements and project specifications. - Prepare Wi-Fi heat maps, access point placement layouts, and coverage reports based on project requirements. Qualifications & Requirements: - Bachelor's degree in Communications, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field. - Minimum 4–6 years of experience in Network Presales or Network Engineering.
